mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 61 degrees at Harriet Park. A full moon is out, and you can spot the International Space Station at 4:12 AM as it crosses from the Northwest over Verona High School toward Madison. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 57 degrees with no rain predicted.

Regarding city news, road work is planned on Highway M for utility connections on Monday and Tuesday, which will include traffic flagging. Also, September is designated as Suicide Prevention Month to raise awareness, and September 1 marks Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to thank those who keep our infrastructure safe.

For upcoming plans, enjoy live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Dane County Farmers Market is Friday, followed by the Verona Area Kids Triathlon this Sunday.
In our weekly police recap, on August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street where a 19-year-old driver was cited for operating with a suspended license.
Culver's of Verona is closed for the evening. Tomorrow, the store opens at 10:00 AM and will be serving the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day.
